import sys

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    MD = 1000000007
    dp = [0] * (n + 2)
    dp[0] = 1
    ans = 0
    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(i, n + 1):
            if (i + j) % 2 == 1:
                ans = (ans + dp[j]) % MD
            dp[j + 1] = (dp[j + 1] + dp[j]) % MD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
